translations.translatedText: # Saturday 16.4.2022 (radio)
Ukraine. Losses in the war. Restaurants. Nordea. al-Aqsa. Weather forecast.
## Russia's strikes on Ukraine
![A large cloud of smoke rises above buildings.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_2835,h_1594,x_0,y_217/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-942874625a6fcf6b6ff/1650339449)
Open image viewer
Smoke rises in the Darnytskyi district of Kyiv. Photo: Metin Semiz / AOP
Russia has continued its strikes on Ukraine. On Saturday Russia carried out air strikes at least near the capital Kyiv and near the city of Lviv.
Russia says that it has fired missiles near Kyiv at a factory that makes tanks.
Russia said on Friday that it would increase strikes near Kyiv.
## Ukraine's losses
![Volodymyr Zelenskyy puts a headphone to his ear.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_2574,h_1447,x_0,y_237/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-942853625a3ded4eab3/1650339838)
Open image viewer
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy spoke in an interview with the news channel CNN. Photo: Sergey Dolzhenko / EPA

Ukrainian President \*\*Volodymyr Zelenskyy \*\*has reported on Ukraine's losses. Zelenskyy says that about 2,500–3,000 Ukrainian soldiers have died because of Russia's attack, and about 10,000 Ukrainian soldiers have been wounded.
Ukrainian President Zelenskyy told about this in an interview with the American news channel CNN.
Zelenskyy estimates that as many as 20,000 Russian soldiers have died.
## Finns in restaurants

![Restaurateur Joonas Keskinen serves at the bar counter.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_128/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-90914761f926d7b1d86/1643718810)
Open image viewer
Finns have started going to restaurants and bars again. Photo: Mikko Koski / Yle
Finns have started going to restaurants again after the corona break.

Many restaurant companies say that restaurant sales have grown a lot compared with last spring. For example, the S Group says that now, at the start of April, restaurant sales have even quadrupled compared with April last year.
Many Finns have not been to restaurants for a long time because of corona. Now the restrictions have been removed, and you can go to restaurants again.
## Nordea's online bank problems
![Nordea's internet bank on mobile.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1920,h_1080,x_0,y_78/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6459315e523d3a075c8/1582448010)
Open image viewer
There have been disruptions recently in Nordea's online services. Photo: All Over Press
Nordea's online bank service had a disruption on Saturday. Because of the fault, it looked as if some customers' accounts had no money.

Nordea says that the cause of the fault was a technical disruption. Customers' money is safe in their accounts, but because of the disruption the balance was not shown correctly in Nordea's online service.
Nordea also had a similar disruption last Friday. Then too, Nordea said that the cause of the fault was a technical disruption.
## Violence at the al-Aqsa mosque

![Young Palestinians threw stones and tried to protect themselves against police rubber bullets outside the Al-Aqsa mosque on Friday morning.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_2836,h_1595,x_0,y_81/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-94274462592762c1dba/1650010589)
Open image viewer
There was unrest near the al-Aqsa mosque on Friday. Photo: Lehtikuva
The USA is worried about the violence in Jerusalem, in which more than 150 people were injured. On Friday Israeli police clashed with Palestinian protesters at the al-Aqsa mosque in Jerusalem.
The US State Department says that all people must stay calm, and that other people must not be provoked by actions or words.
The USA urges Palestinians and Israeli authorities to cooperate so that tensions between the parties decrease.
## The weather
![Sunday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12407670)
Open image viewer
On Sunday it is fairly warm in most of the country.

Cloudiness on Sunday varies, that is, at times it is cloudy and at times the sun shines. Cloudiness is greatest in the east. The temperature is between 2 in the north and as much as 13 degrees in the south
